sentences.en: I'm Jenna Fisher.
And I'm Angela Kinsey.
We were on The Office together.
sentences.zh: 我们曾一起出演《办公室》。

sentences.en: And we're best friends.
And now we're doing the Ultimate Office rewatch podcast just for you.
sentences.zh: 现在我们正为你们制作《办公室》终极重温播客。

sentences.en: Each week, we will break down an episode of The Office and give exclusive behind-the-scenes stories that only two people who were there can tell you.
sentences.zh: 每周，我们都会深度解析一集《办公室》，并分享只有身临其境的我们才能告诉你的独家幕后故事。

sentences.en: We're The Office ladies.
Hi there.
Today, we're going to talk about manager and salesman.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们要聊聊《经理与销售员》这一集。

sentences.en: We have a huge episode.
It really is.
It is Season 6, Episode 16, written by Mindy Kaling and directed by Mark Webb.
sentences.zh: 这是第六季第十六集，由敏迪·卡灵编剧，马克·韦布执导。

sentences.en: Hit us with a summary, lady.
sentences.zh: 给我们来个剧情梗概吧，女士。

sentences.en: Here it is.
Sabre CEO Joe Bennett visits Dunder Mifflin Scranton.
sentences.zh: 赛博公司的首席执行官乔·贝内特造访了邓德·米夫林斯克兰顿分公司。

sentences.en: She brings her two Great Danes, her autobiography, and a lot of new policies.
sentences.zh: 她带来了两只大丹犬、她的自传以及许多新政策。

sentences.en: When she discovers that Michael and Jim are co-managers, she tells them there can only be one manager.
sentences.zh: 当她发现迈克尔和吉姆是共同经理时，她告诉他们只能留下一位经理。

sentences.en: And they have until the end of the day to decide who will be a salesperson and who will stay on as manager.
sentences.zh: 他们必须在下班前决定谁去做销售员，谁留任经理。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, Andy is handing out Valentine's cards to everyone in The Office, which sparks confusion as to where his affections truly lie.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，安迪给办公室里的每个人都发了情人节贺卡，这让大家对他到底心仪谁感到困惑。

sentences.en: I am telling you, watching Andy and Aaron is making me crazy.
sentences.zh: 我跟你说，看安迪和艾琳的互动简直让我抓狂。

sentences.en: I just want one of them to just say, I like you.
sentences.zh: 我真希望他们中有一个人能直接说出“我喜欢你”。

sentences.en: I know, but they have the thing where neither one of them will ask the other one out.
sentences.zh: 我知道，但他们就是那种谁也不肯先开口约对方的情况。

sentences.en: It's making me crazy.
It's very sweet.
It is sweet, but it's making me crazy.
sentences.zh: 确实甜蜜，但真的让我抓狂。

sentences.en: Fast fact number one, Kathy Bates is Joe Bennett.
sentences.zh: 第一个速览事实，凯西·贝茨饰演乔·贝内特。

sentences.en: Kathy Flippin' Bates.
Now, I know she was on last week's episode, but it was via a computer screen.
sentences.zh: 我知道她上周那一集也出现了，但那是通过电脑屏幕。

sentences.en: Here she is, live, in person.
sentences.zh: 而这一次，她是真人亲临现场。

sentences.en: Walking right next to us, talking to us.
sentences.zh: 就在我们身边走动，和我们交谈。

sentences.en: You know, Kathy Bates is one of just a few actors who have been nominated for the triple crown of acting.
sentences.zh: 你们知道吗，凯西·贝茨是少数几位获得过表演“大满贯”提名的演员之一。

sentences.en: That means that she has been nominated for a Tony for her work on the stage, an Academy Award for film, an Emmy for television.
sentences.zh: 这意味着她曾因舞台表演获得托尼奖提名，因电影获得奥斯卡奖提名，因电视作品获得艾美奖提名。

sentences.en: By the way, she has won an Academy Award, two Golden Globes, two SAG Awards, and two Emmy Awards.
sentences.zh: 顺便提一下，她还获得过一座奥斯卡奖、两座金球奖、两座演员工会奖和两座艾美奖。

sentences.en: Her nominations for awards were so many that I actually got confused.
sentences.zh: 她的获奖提名多到让我都搞糊涂了。

sentences.en: I couldn't even track them all.
It's so many.
Yeah, so you guys, we were a little nervous.
sentences.zh: 是啊，所以大家，我们当时有点紧张。

sentences.en: I mean, this acting legend came in to our job.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这位表演界的传奇人物来到了我们的工作场所。

sentences.en: We got a lot of mail, Angela, asking what was our reaction to having Kathy Bates.
sentences.zh: 安吉拉，我们收到了很多邮件，问我们见到凯西·贝茨时是什么反应。

sentences.en: I mean, I think you just heard it.
sentences.zh: 我想你们刚才已经听到了。

sentences.en: We were so excited, but I was really nervous.
sentences.zh: 我们非常兴奋，但我真的很紧张。

sentences.en: I was intimidated.
Yeah, but not by anything other than just her presence, because she's very lovely, you know.
sentences.zh: 是啊，但并不是因为别的，仅仅是因为她的气场，因为她本人非常可爱，你们懂的。

sentences.en: Oh, yes.
She was so nice to everyone.
Oh, my gosh, yes.
She's super down to earth and kind.
sentences.zh: 她超级平易近人，而且很友善。

sentences.en: Yeah.
But her legacy that followed her into the room was massive.
sentences.zh: 但她带进房间的那种传奇光环依然非常强大。

sentences.en: Yes, she had this quiet power as she walked in the room.
sentences.zh: 是的，她走进房间时自带一种沉静的力量。

sentences.en: I was so, like, nervous to say anything to her.
sentences.zh: 我当时特别紧张，不知道该怎么跟她开口。

sentences.en: You know, my hair colorist of over 20 years, Robert Hickland, I love this man,
sentences.zh: 你知道，我那合作了二十多年的染发师罗伯特·希克兰，我超爱他，

sentences.en: he told me once that he also colored Kathy Bates' hair once.
sentences.zh: 他有次跟我说，他也给凯西·贝茨染过头发。

sentences.en: What?
This was before Kathy was on our show.
sentences.zh: 那是在凯西上我们节目之前的事了。

sentences.en: He said, oh, I don't know how she came up.
sentences.zh: 他说，噢，我不记得是怎么聊到她的了。

sentences.en: But he was like, I colored her hair once.
sentences.zh: 但他就是说，我给她的头发染过色。

sentences.en: And when he told me that, I was floored.
sentences.zh: 当他告诉我这件事时，我简直惊呆了。

sentences.en: And now here she was.
She had come in.
And I remember that I was sitting at the reception desk.
sentences.zh: 我记得当时我正坐在接待台那儿。

sentences.en: And it was like, I wanted to be like, my hairdresser did your hair once.
sentences.zh: 我当时就想说，我的发型师给你染过头发。

sentences.en: No.
Like, I.
Suppress, suppress.
Don't say it.
Yes, yes.
But I was like, moment of connection.
sentences.zh: 但我当时就觉得，这是一个建立联系的时刻。

sentences.en: I have something in common with you.
The same man has colored her hair.
sentences.zh: 同一个人给我们的头发染过色。

sentences.en: That is what I was so nervous.
sentences.zh: 这就是我当时那么紧张的原因。

sentences.en: And I had to, like, make sure I didn't do that.
sentences.zh: 我得确保自己没把这话说出口。

sentences.en: I do think that, like, eventually by day three, I did tell her that tidbit.
sentences.zh: 我觉得，大概到了第三天，我还是把这个小八卦告诉她了。

sentences.en: And it was, you know, the response you would expect, which was, oh.
sentences.zh: 然后，你知道，反应正如你所料，就是，噢。

sentences.en: Anyway.
Kathy Bates was on Anderson when Anderson Cooper had his own talk show.
sentences.zh: 凯西·贝茨曾上过安德森·库珀主持的脱口秀节目。

sentences.en: And she talked about being on The Office.
sentences.zh: 她谈到了出演《办公室》的经历。

sentences.en: And I thought we could give it a listen.
How was it like working with the comedy ensemble versus the cast on Harry's Law?
sentences.zh: 和《办公室》的喜剧团队合作，与《律政俏师太》的剧组相比，感觉如何？

sentences.en: Well, I was so in awe of Steve Carell, you know.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我对史蒂夫·卡瑞尔非常敬佩，你知道的。

sentences.en: And actually, I had worked with Rainn Wilson.
sentences.zh: 而且实际上，我和雷恩·威尔森合作过。

sentences.en: I actually cast him when I was directing an episode of Six Feet Under.
sentences.zh: 我在执导《六尺之下》的一集时，其实是我选的他。

sentences.en: Oh, really?
Way, way back.
Of course.
He was great on Six Feet Under.
sentences.zh: 他在《六尺之下》里表现得很棒。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
He was terrific.
And so it's been wonderful to watch him on The Office just knock it out of the ballpark all the time.
sentences.zh: 所以看到他在《办公室》里一直表现得那么精彩，真是太棒了。

sentences.en: But it was great to work with Steve Carell.
sentences.zh: 能和史蒂夫·卡瑞尔合作真的很棒。

sentences.en: And I loved working with the two great Danes.
sentences.zh: 而且我很喜欢和那两位伟大的丹麦人合作。

sentences.en: That was a lot of fun.
So I didn't know this until I saw this clip.
sentences.zh: 所以直到看到这段视频，我才知道这件事。

sentences.en: She has actually directed a ton of television, including five episodes of Six Feet Under.
sentences.zh: 她其实执导过大量的电视作品，包括五集《六尺之下》。

sentences.en: And like she said, she directed Rainn Wilson.
sentences.zh: 就像她说的，她执导过雷恩·威尔森。

sentences.en: So I reached out to Rainn.
Oh, you did?
Yeah.
And he described the experience as a, quote, double whammy.
sentences.zh: 他把那次经历形容为，引用他的话，双重打击。

sentences.en: He said, I got a major role on one of the deepest, most respected TV shows going on.
sentences.zh: 他说，我当时在一部最深刻、最受推崇的电视节目中获得了一个重要角色。

sentences.en: It was on HBO, no less.
And at the same time, I was being directed by an Oscar winner.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，我还在一位奥斯卡得主的执导下演戏。

sentences.en: He said it was a dream come true that she was an excellent director.
sentences.zh: 他说能由她执导简直是梦想成真，她是一位出色的导演。

sentences.en: He said they rehearsed a lot and she gave great notes, which, of course, wasn't surprising.
sentences.zh: 他说他们排练了很多次，她给出的建议也非常棒，当然，这并不令人意外。

sentences.en: But he said he was definitely quite intimidated, which made him act very formal and somewhat awkward around her.
sentences.zh: 但他表示自己确实感到相当紧张，这让他跟她相处时表现得非常拘谨，甚至有些笨拙。

sentences.en: Wait, more awkward than usual for Rainn?
sentences.zh: 等等，比平时的雷恩还要笨拙？

sentences.en: Exactly.
But he said this was actually perfect for the character he was playing.
sentences.zh: 但他表示这对于他当时饰演的角色来说其实非常完美。

sentences.en: Oh, right.
But the very first episode that he did of Six Feet Under was directed by Kathy Bates.
sentences.zh: 但他参演的第一集《六尺之下》就是由凯西·贝茨执导的。

sentences.en: So she was a big part of picking him for that role that became a major recurring role for him.
sentences.zh: 所以她在挑选他出演那个后来成为他重要常驻角色的过程中起到了很大作用。

sentences.en: Wow.
So she was a pivotal person in his life.
sentences.zh: 所以她是他人生的关键人物。

sentences.en: Yeah.
In his career.
sentences.zh: 在他职业生涯中的关键人物。

sentences.en: Yes.
That is so cool.
Well, fast fact number two, Kathy mentioned, on Anderson, the Great Danes.
sentences.zh: 好了，第二个小知识，凯西在安德森的节目里提到了大丹犬。

sentences.en: I remember the Great Danes.
How could we forget the Great Danes?
sentences.zh: 我们怎么可能忘记那些大丹犬呢？

sentences.en: Two small, like ponies were on set with us.
sentences.zh: 有两只像小马一样大的狗和我们一起在片场。

sentences.en: Yes, and on set with us a lot.
sentences.zh: 是的，而且经常和我们一起在片场。

sentences.en: Randy Cordray said that we once again went to Bob Dunn's Animal Services and their head trainer, Denise Sanders, came through for us.
sentences.zh: 兰迪·科德雷说我们再次找到了鲍勃·邓恩动物服务公司，他们的首席训练师丹妮丝·桑德斯帮了我们大忙。

sentences.en: The dogs' names were Gabby and Guinness.
sentences.zh: 那两只狗的名字叫加比和吉尼斯。

sentences.en: He said they were truly majestic, gorgeous, and very well-disciplined.
sentences.zh: 他说它们真的非常威严、漂亮，而且训练有素。

sentences.en: I remember that.
They were really amazing.
Incidentally, David Denman had a Great Dane who I spent quite a bit of time with.
sentences.zh: 顺便提一下，大卫·丹曼有一只大丹犬，我花了不少时间跟它相处。

sentences.en: And I remember this thing where David Denman told me that Great Danes are great apartment dogs.
sentences.zh: 我记得大卫·丹曼当时跟我说，大丹犬是非常适合在公寓养的狗。

sentences.en: How so?
He said they're just really, really chill and they actually don't need a lot of exercise.
sentences.zh: 他说它们真的非常冷静，其实不需要太多的运动。

sentences.en: That a lot of smaller dogs are far more active.
sentences.zh: 很多小型犬反而要活跃得多。

sentences.en: They need to go out.
They need walking.
But Great Danes are kind of like just big loungers.
sentences.zh: 但大丹犬就像是那种大型的“躺平族”。

sentences.en: That makes sense.
You know, my little chihuahua mixes, they get what we call the zoomies.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我的吉娃娃混种犬，它们会有我们所谓的“疯狂冲刺”。

sentences.en: Yes.
Where they zoom around and run and run and run in a circle.
sentences.zh: 就是它们会绕着圈不停地跑啊跑啊跑。

sentences.en: Maggie is a large dog.
She's a shepherd mix.
That's Jenna's dog.
It's like eight times the size of my dog.
sentences.zh: 它体型大概是我家狗的八倍大。

sentences.en: And Maggie also gets the zoomies.
She does.
I've seen her.
And it's like, get out of the way.
sentences.zh: 那种时候简直就是：快闪开。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
She'll take you down.
I wanted to know a little bit more about this to make sure that this, you know, anecdote from David Denman that I remembered all these years was true.
sentences.zh: 我想多了解一点这方面的信息，以确认我多年来一直记得的大卫·丹曼的这段轶事是否属实。

sentences.en: And, yes, according to City Dogs Life, Great Danes make great apartment dogs.
sentences.zh: 没错，根据“城市狗狗生活”网站的说法，大丹犬非常适合在公寓里饲养。

sentences.en: But they had a list of three things that you might want to consider if you are going to put a Great Dane in a small apartment.
sentences.zh: 但他们列出了三点建议，如果你打算在小公寓里养大丹犬，可能需要考虑一下。

sentences.en: And they are, number one, just simply the great amount of space that the dog will take up, even standing in a hallway.
sentences.zh: 第一点，仅仅是这只狗会占据巨大的空间，哪怕只是站在走廊里。

sentences.en: I mean, good point.
Number two, the potential for a Great Dane to accidentally knock over pictures, vases, and other furnishings with their long, powerful tails.
sentences.zh: 第二点，大丹犬可能会用它们长而有力的尾巴不小心撞倒照片、花瓶和其他家具。

sentences.en: Yes.
Yes.
And three, the loudness of their bark might bother your neighbors.
sentences.zh: 第三点，它们的叫声很大，可能会打扰到邻居。

sentences.en: But in terms of being chill, they're great in an apartment.
sentences.zh: 但就性格沉稳而言，它们在公寓里表现得很棒。

sentences.en: So, when we watched this episode to prepare for today's podcast, I had actually also just watched a show with our youngest son about the world's biggest dogs.
sentences.zh: 所以，当我们为了准备今天的播客观看这一集时，我其实刚和我家小儿子一起看了一档关于世界最大犬种的节目。

sentences.en: And, of course, Great Danes make that liSt.
sentences.zh: 当然，大丹犬也榜上有名。

sentences.en: Are they number one?
They are not number one because the world's biggest dogs are measured on weight and height.
sentences.zh: 它们不是第一名，因为世界最大犬种是按体重和身高来衡量的。

sentences.en: Oh.
But they are among the tallest, standing at around 30 to 34 inches tall.
sentences.zh: 但它们属于最高的犬种之一，身高大约在30到34英寸之间。

sentences.en: And I guess Great Danes were a result of a crossbreed between an English Mastiff, which is the biggest dog.
sentences.zh: 我猜大丹犬是英国獒犬（体型最大的狗）和爱尔兰猎狼犬（体型第二大的狗）杂交的结果。

sentences.en: Oh.
And the Irish Wolfhound, which is the second biggest dog.
sentences.zh: 爱尔兰猎狼犬是体型第二大的狗。

sentences.en: Oh.
So, you know, these are big, big animals.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，这些都是非常非常大的动物。

sentences.en: But a quote I read online about Great Danes says,
sentences.zh: 但我读到过一段关于大丹犬的评价，上面说，

sentences.en: they are known for their kind and playful natures and make excellent family dogs.
sentences.zh: 它们以善良和爱玩的天性著称，是极好的家庭犬。

sentences.en: I believe it.
But, you know, Maggie has that working shepherd in her, and she needs to be busy with a job all the time.
sentences.zh: 但你知道，玛吉身上有牧羊犬的工作基因，她需要一直有活干才行。

sentences.en: But I think Great Danes are like, you know what?
sentences.zh: 但我认为大丹犬会觉得，你知道吗？

sentences.en: It's fine.
Let's just hang out.
Let's just watch TV.
Let's just hang out.
Yeah.
Scooby-Doo was a Great Dane, right?
sentences.zh: 史酷比是一只大丹犬，对吧？

sentences.en: Yeah.
Yeah.
Robbie.
I mean, he solved mysteries.
sentences.zh: 我是说，它可是破案高手。

sentences.en: All right.
Fast fact number three is all about our director, Mark Webb.
sentences.zh: 第三个速览事实是关于我们的导演马克·韦布的。

sentences.en: Big timey director alert, everybody.
Yeah.
Now, Mark started as an editor and then as a music video director.
sentences.zh: 马克最初是一名剪辑师，后来成为了一名音乐录影带导演。

sentences.en: He directed videos for Good Charlotte, Snow Patrol, Maroon 5, and Green Day.
sentences.zh: 他曾执导过Good Charlotte、Snow Patrol、Maroon 5和Green Day的音乐录影带。

sentences.en: I saw that, and I went and watched the video.
sentences.zh: 我看到了，还特意去看了那个录影带。

sentences.en: You did?
Yeah.
Mark's feature film debut was the movie 500 Days of Summer, starring Zooey Deschanel and Joseph Gordon-Levitt.
sentences.zh: 马克的长片处女作是电影《和莎莫的500天》，由佐伊·丹斯切尔和约瑟夫·高登-莱维特主演。

sentences.en: If you haven't watched it, it is, like, just the most charming movie ever.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没看过，它简直是有史以来最迷人的电影了。

sentences.en: It's a beautiful movie.
Mm-hmm.
And you know what?
All of his background with music videos, any wonder he was so perfect for that movie.
sentences.zh: 他有那么多音乐录影带的背景，难怪他能把那部电影拍得那么完美。

sentences.en: Yeah, because there's, like, singing and dancing numbers in it.
sentences.zh: 没错，因为里面有那种唱歌跳舞的桥段。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
He also directed The Amazing Spider-Man, starring Andrew Garfield and Emma Stone, and the sequel, The Amazing Spider-Man 2.
sentences.zh: 他还执导了由安德鲁·加菲尔德和艾玛·斯通主演的《超凡蜘蛛侠》，以及续集《超凡蜘蛛侠2》。

sentences.en: But I believe The Office was his first time directing for television.
sentences.zh: 但我相信《办公室》是他第一次执导电视剧。

sentences.en: Since then, he's directed a lot of television.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，他执导了很多电视剧。

sentences.en: He's done episodes of Crazy Ex-Girlfriend and Limitless.
sentences.zh: 他拍过《疯狂前女友》和《永无止境》的剧集。

sentences.en: But we started his TV career in directing.
sentences.zh: 但我们开启了他的电视导演生涯。

Yeah, I think it is, a shakedown.
I don't know if that's the right term, but basically they're, like—
sentences.zh: 我不知道这词用得对不对，但基本上他们就是……

sentences.en: It is the right term because I just watched an episode of Abbott Elementary, and they have a whole plot line about shakedowns.
sentences.zh: 这词用得对，因为我刚看了集《小学风云》，里面有一整条剧情线就是讲敲诈勒索的。

sentences.en: Okay, so there's a shakedown.
sentences.zh: 好吧，所以这就是敲诈勒索。

sentences.en: I learned something.
There you have it.
But they're basically like, Nick, you're going to help us get Jim's password to his computer, and if you don't, we're going to do these kind of things.
sentences.zh: 但他们基本上就是说，尼克，你要帮我们拿到吉姆电脑的密码，如果你不帮，我们就会做这些事。

sentences.en: And then Ryan has to struggle to crush a can, yes?
sentences.zh: 然后瑞安得费劲去捏扁一个易拉罐，对吧？

sentences.en: But then Dwight completely crushes an apple.
sentences.zh: 但接着德怀特直接把一个苹果捏碎了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
We got a fan question from Laura S.
sentences.zh: 我们收到一个来自劳拉·S的粉丝提问。

sentences.en: in Australia.
How did Rain crush the apple?
sentences.zh: 雷恩是怎么捏碎那个苹果的？

sentences.en: Was it a fakie apple, or is he just super strong?
sentences.zh: 那是假苹果，还是他力气真的那么大？

sentences.en: Her Randy Cordray, Dwight's crushing of the apple, was just real.
sentences.zh: 兰迪·科德雷说，德怀特捏碎苹果那段是真的。

sentences.en: They used a real apple.
He said they did a bunch of practice runs.
sentences.zh: 他说他们排练了好多次。

sentences.en: They didn't drill any holes in it or, like, help him a little.
sentences.zh: 他们没在苹果上钻孔，也没给他提供什么帮助。

sentences.en: Okay, so they did kind of score the backside of the apple so that it could break away more easily, but they didn't do anything to the front.
sentences.zh: 好吧，他们确实在苹果背面划了几道，让它更容易裂开，但正面什么都没动。

sentences.en: It's a real apple.
He said Rain's fingertips were just strong enough to dig into the front of the apple, and then it broke away because of some of the scoring on the back.
sentences.zh: 他说雷恩的指尖力气足够大，能抠进苹果正面，然后因为背面的划痕，苹果就裂开了。

sentences.en: But, I mean, just that part, the part where they go into the front is really impressive.
sentences.zh: 但我是说，光是那一部分，也就是手指抠进苹果正面的那部分，真的让人印象深刻。

sentences.en: Good job, Rain.
Who knew?
You know, that's the thing.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这就是问题所在。

sentences.en: Like, as an actor, especially being a television actor, because they generate scripts on an ongoing basis, and they'll just write something, and suddenly you're like,
sentences.zh: 作为一名演员，尤其是电视剧演员，因为剧本是持续创作的，他们会突然写出一些情节，然后你就会想，

sentences.en: Oh, I guess this week I'm skateboarding.
sentences.zh: 噢，看来这周我要玩滑板了。

sentences.en: I've never been on a skateboard before.
And then you have, like, one week to figure out how to be a good enough skateboarder to pull off whatever they've written.
sentences.zh: 然后你只有一周的时间去琢磨怎么成为一个足够好的滑板手，来完成他们写出的戏份。

sentences.en: And in this case, like, how lucky are they that Rain could crush an apple with his fingertips?
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，雷恩能用指尖捏碎苹果，他们得有多幸运啊？

sentences.en: No one asked.
And then if he couldn't have done it, what would they have done?
sentences.zh: 如果他做不到，他们会怎么办？

sentences.en: Would they have rewritten it?
Would they have found a fakie apple?
I don't know.
So, our romantic comedy is about to begin.
sentences.zh: 好了，我们的浪漫喜剧要开始了。

sentences.en: Kelly's at the copier.
Yep.
Andy walks up behind her, and she turns around and goes, Oh, you scared me.
sentences.zh: 安迪走到她身后，她转过身说，噢，你吓到我了。

sentences.en: I didn't see you there.
I mean, she is laying it on so thick.
sentences.zh: 我是说，她表现得太刻意了。

sentences.en: She touches his arm, gives him a kiss on the cheek.
sentences.zh: 她摸了摸他的手臂，还在他脸颊上亲了一下。

sentences.en: He's so confused.
He's so confused.
And that's when Meredith comes up and goes, We saw the card you gave her.
sentences.zh: 就在这时，梅雷迪思走过来，说，我们看到你给她的卡片了。

sentences.en: You gave that to me, we'd be doing it.
sentences.zh: 你要是把那个给我，我们早就上床了。

sentences.en: I know.
She said something like that.
And he's like, What?
sentences.zh: 然后他一脸茫然，说，什么？

sentences.en: Now Andy's freaked out.
He realizes what has happened, and Erin has seen the whole thing.
sentences.zh: 他意识到发生了什么，而艾琳目睹了全过程。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
Meanwhile, Michael is going to walk into what is now Jim's office and say he wants his old job back because he cannot handle the farty dirt patch that is the sales floor.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，迈克尔打算走进吉姆现在的办公室，说他想拿回原来的职位，因为他受不了销售部那块像屁一样的脏地盘。

sentences.en: Oh, well, Jim says the grass is always greener.
sentences.zh: 哦，好吧，吉姆说草总是那边更绿。

sentences.en: And he's like, There's no grass out there.
sentences.zh: 然后迈克尔说，外面根本没有草。

sentences.en: It's just a farty dirt patch.
sentences.zh: 那只是一块像屁一样的脏地盘。

sentences.en: It's amazing.
Jim says, What do you want to do?
They have a very funny exchange here.
sentences.zh: 他们在这里有一段非常有趣的对话。

sentences.en: The difference between Michael's plan and Jim's plan is pretty amazing.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔的计划和吉姆的计划之间的差异真是绝了。

sentences.en: Michael's number one idea is let's make a sign that says it's opposite day.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔的首选方案是做一个写着“今天是反话日”的牌子。

sentences.en: I know.
Done.
Solved.
I know.
And what I love is that Jim's idea is they just walk in and tell Joe that they want to switch jobs.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢的是，吉姆的想法是他们直接走进去告诉乔他们想换工作。

sentences.en: But he has to put it in language Michael will understand by saying, Why don't we do it the lethal weapon way?
sentences.zh: 但他必须用迈克尔能理解的语言来说，比如“我们为什么不按《致命武器》的方式来呢？”

sentences.en: What happens in lethal weapon?
They just walk in and tell their boss what they want, right?
sentences.zh: 他们直接走进去告诉老板他们想要什么，对吧？

sentences.en: Yes.
The lethal weapon way.
Let's do that.
So they do.
They find Joe walking her dogs outside.
sentences.zh: 他们发现乔正在外面遛狗。

sentences.en: She really can't believe that two grown men haven't been able to figure this out.
sentences.zh: 她简直不敢相信两个成年男人竟然连这点事都搞不定。

sentences.en: Two grown-ass men is what she says.
She gets a phone call in the middle of this exchange.
sentences.zh: 在这次交谈中，她接到了一个电话。

sentences.en: She's like, Fine.
My God.
I don't care.
Just stop meeting with me to talk about it.
And here, walk my dogs and don't ride them.
sentences.zh: 还有，帮我遛狗，别骑它们。

sentences.en: Yeah.
A lot of people try to ride them.
I bet they do.
We had a fan question from Catherine H.
sentences.zh: 我们收到一个来自科罗拉多州丹佛市凯瑟琳·H的粉丝提问，

sentences.en: in Denver, Colorado, who wanted to know,
where are the lines and don't ride them?
sentences.zh: “别骑它们”这句台词是哪来的？

sentences.en: A lot of people try to ride them scripted or improvised.
sentences.zh: 很多人都想问这句是剧本写的还是即兴发挥的。

sentences.en: Guys, that was scripted.
The way she delivered that was so amazing.
sentences.zh: 她那句台词的表达方式真是太棒了。

sentences.en: I agree.
Just perfection.
When I reread this shooting draft, like, everything is scripted.
sentences.zh: 当我重读这份拍摄剧本时，发现所有内容都是写好的。

sentences.en: Like, there are moments where I was like, Oh, was that someone going off script?
sentences.zh: 有些时刻我还在想，哦，那是有人脱稿了吗？

sentences.en: No.
This was like all scripted.
Every little moment you see.
sentences.zh: 你看到的每一个小细节。

sentences.en: When Michael messes up Jim's hair earlier, I went to the script.
sentences.zh: 当迈克尔早些时候弄乱吉姆的头发时，我查了剧本。

sentences.en: I was like, Maybe that was Steve just playing around.
sentences.zh: 我当时心想，也许那是史蒂夫在开玩笑。

sentences.en: Nope.
In the script.
Really?
Yep.
It says, Michael messes up Jim's hair.
sentences.zh: 上面写着，迈克尔弄乱了吉姆的头发。

sentences.en: Well, Andy's going to quickly make an announcement to the bullpen that he has sent an email saying,
sentences.zh: 嗯，安迪很快会向办公区宣布，他发了一封邮件说，

sentences.en: Look, if you think I like you because of this Valentine's card, I'm paraphrasing,
sentences.zh: 听着，如果你以为我因为这张情人节贺卡而喜欢你——我这是意译——

sentences.en: but basically, I don't like you.
sentences.zh: 但基本上就是，我不喜欢你。

sentences.en: Okay?
Yeah.
It meant nothing to me.
It meant nothing.
Well, Kelly comes in wide open.
sentences.zh: 然后凯莉直接冲了进来。

sentences.en: Hey!
Hey!
Very nice.
Kelly's mad because she's like, Do you not like me?
sentences.zh: 凯莉很生气，她质问说，你是不喜欢我吗？

sentences.en: I would have liked you so hard.
sentences.zh: 我本来会非常用心地喜欢你的。

sentences.en: And Andy tells Kelly, There's someone else.
sentences.zh: 然后安迪告诉凯莉，我有别人了。

sentences.en: But he won't say who.
Mm-mm.
There was a deleted Andy talking head.
sentences.zh: 有一段安迪的采访被删减了。

sentences.en: Ooh, what did it say?
He said, I gave Kelly $50 and she promised to stop loving me.
sentences.zh: 他说，我给了凯莉50美元，她答应不再爱我了。

sentences.en: Okay.
That's pretty great.
But Aaron's happy now because it turned out Andy didn't like Kelly.
sentences.zh: 但亚伦现在很高兴，因为结果证明安迪并不喜欢凯莉。

sentences.en: And Michael is happy as well because he's back in his office.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔也很高兴，因为他回到了自己的办公室。

sentences.en: And Aaron has set up all of his gadgets and they're going to have a little dance party.
sentences.zh: 亚伦架好了他所有的设备，他们要开个小型舞会。

sentences.en: At 20 minutes, one second, Aaron activates Michael's little Casio keyboard and we hear two pieces of music.
sentences.zh: 在20分01秒时，亚伦启动了迈克尔那个卡西欧小键盘，我们听到了两段音乐。

sentences.en: Randy Cordray said they were loop tracks that were found by our sound supervisor, Bobby Maxton.
sentences.zh: 兰迪·科德雷说那是我们的音效主管鲍比·麦克斯顿找到的循环音轨。

sentences.en: We licensed those song loops in perpetuity and it cost $3,000.
sentences.zh: 我们永久买下了这些歌曲循环的版权，花了3000美元。

sentences.en: Well, Dwight is just delighted that Jim is no longer manager.
sentences.zh: 嗯，德怀特对吉姆不再担任经理感到非常高兴。

sentences.en: He rubs it in that his time as manager lasted four hours.
sentences.zh: 他嘲讽吉姆的经理任期只持续了四个小时。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's the shortest of any manager.
sentences.zh: 没错，这是所有经理里最短的。

sentences.en: He's holding a Sheetz coffee mug, by the way.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，他手里拿着一个Sheetz的咖啡杯。

sentences.en: Nice!
Yeah, Jim is going to take Dwight's tie and dip it in his coffee.
sentences.zh: 是的，吉姆要把德怀特的领带浸到他的咖啡里。

sentences.en: Oh, Jim.
In the shooting draft, this scene continued and you see Jim back in the annex and Toby is writing him up.
sentences.zh: 在拍摄剧本中，这一幕还在继续，你看到吉姆回到了附楼，托比正在写他的违规记录。

sentences.en: What?
Yes!
And there's this B-roll and Jim has taken Dwight's phone and has put it in Jell-O and put it in the fridge.
sentences.zh: 还有一段空镜，吉姆拿走了德怀特的手机，把它放进果冻里，然后塞进了冰箱。

sentences.en: And Toby says, please don't make this a habit.
sentences.zh: 托比说，请不要养成这种习惯。

sentences.en: And Jim is just smiling.
The pranks are coming back, guys!
Well, everybody was very excited for this storyline.
sentences.zh: 嗯，大家对这个剧情线都非常兴奋。

sentences.en: The writers spoke about how, for a while, they really liked this storyline where Jim was having to be more ambitious, he was having to be in charge, be a little serious.
sentences.zh: 编剧们谈到，有一段时间他们真的很喜欢吉姆不得不变得更有野心、不得不负责任、变得严肃一点的剧情线。

sentences.en: But they really missed the dynamic between Jim and Dwight.
sentences.zh: 但他们真的很怀念吉姆和德怀特之间的那种互动关系。

sentences.en: This was something that was sacrificed because of this storyline.
sentences.zh: 这是因为这个故事情节而不得不做出的牺牲。

sentences.en: Now they were going to get to have it back.
sentences.zh: 现在他们终于可以把它找回来了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
Well, Dwight and Ryan congratulate themselves for dethroning Jim, even though they're not quite sure what it was that they did that contributed to this.
sentences.zh: 嗯，德怀特和瑞安为自己把吉姆拉下马而沾沾自喜，尽管他们并不确定自己到底做了什么才导致了这一结果。

sentences.en: You know, you're going to see them get into the elevator and they're happy and then they get out of the elevator and they're arguing.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你会看到他们走进电梯时很高兴，然后电梯门一开，他们就在争吵。

sentences.en: You know, they had to film those on two different days because, you know, the elevator doesn't really go anywhere.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们必须在两天内分别拍摄这些镜头，因为电梯其实根本不会动。

sentences.en: Right, right.
So they got into an elevator and then it was like a total other day where they did the leaving of the elevator.
sentences.zh: 所以他们走进电梯，然后完全是另一天拍摄的走出电梯的戏份。

sentences.en: Well, I loved it.
I loved how it's the misdirect, right?
That these two are going to go for a drink and then the doors open and they're arguing.
sentences.zh: 这两个人本来要去喝一杯，结果门一开他们就在吵架。

sentences.en: Just one elevator ride later.
sentences.zh: 仅仅过了一次电梯行程而已。

sentences.en: It's only like a two-story building.
This is a short ride to get in a fight.
sentences.zh: 这趟电梯坐得够短的，居然还能吵起来。

sentences.en: Right.
The thing they're arguing about is what drink they're going to get to celebrate.
sentences.zh: 他们争论的内容是去喝什么酒庆祝。

sentences.en: Dwight says martini bars are pretentious.
sentences.zh: 德怀特说马提尼酒吧太做作了。

sentences.en: And then Ryan says, I'm not interested in anything I have to make myself.
sentences.zh: 然后瑞安说，我可不想喝那种还得我自己调的酒。

sentences.en: And Dwight's like, it's beet vodka and it's delicious.
sentences.zh: 德怀特就说，那是甜菜伏特加，味道好极了。

sentences.en: I will show you.
I got curious if beet vodka was a real thing.
sentences.zh: 我很好奇甜菜伏特加是不是真的存在。

sentences.en: Is it?
Okay.
I looked this up online.
This is what I found.
There might be others, but I did find a vodka from Minnesota called BET, and there's a line over the E.
sentences.zh: 可能还有其他的，但我确实找到了一种来自明尼苏达州的伏特加，名字叫BET，E上面还有一横。

sentences.en: BET, beet vodka.
It's Minnesota's first vodka distilled from 100% sugar beets.
sentences.zh: 这是明尼苏达州第一款用100%糖甜菜蒸馏而成的伏特加。

sentences.en: Sugar beets?
Yes.
I was not able to get that vodka in time, but I also read that you can make your own beet-infused vodka.
sentences.zh: 我没能及时买到那种伏特加，但我还读到你可以自己制作甜菜浸泡伏特加。

sentences.en: And I looked up the recipe, and I made it.
sentences.zh: 我查了食谱，然后我就做了。

sentences.en: You did not.
I did.
You made beet-infused vodka?
sentences.zh: 你做了甜菜浸泡伏特加？

sentences.en: Explain.
Okay.
I found a recipe on allrecipes.com.
sentences.zh: 我在allrecipes.com上找到了一个食谱。

sentences.en: This one is by Jonah Luck.
Giving you a shout-out, Jonah.
Here's the quote about this recipe.
sentences.zh: 这是关于这个食谱的评价。

sentences.en: This is a full-flavored and earthy vodka that will keep you coming back.
sentences.zh: 这是一款风味浓郁、带有泥土气息的伏特加，会让你回味无穷。

sentences.en: Hmm.
The ingredients were two pounds of beets, peeled and cubed.
sentences.zh: 配料是两磅甜菜，去皮切块。

sentences.en: I went to the store.
I bought a lot of beets.
I peeled them.
My hands were red.
I was trying to hide them from you the other day on our edit because my hands were so stained from peeling these beets,
sentences.zh: 前几天剪辑的时候我一直试图向你隐瞒，因为我的手被削甜菜染得太红了，

sentences.en: and I cubed them and cut them in little squares on Monday.
sentences.zh: 周一的时候我把它们切成了小方块。

sentences.en: I have to stop you.
Mm-hmm.
What was the reaction to the people in the store when Angela came in and bought two pounds of beets?
sentences.zh: 安吉拉去店里买了整整两磅甜菜时，店里的人是什么反应？

sentences.en: At the checkout line, the guy checking me out, you could see everything in him.
sentences.zh: 在结账排队时，那个给我结账的伙计，你能看穿他的一切心思。

sentences.en: It was like you could see the vein in his forehead.
sentences.zh: 就好像能看到他额头上的青筋一样。

sentences.en: He had to weigh the beets, and he was like, you're buying beets?
sentences.zh: 他得给甜菜称重，他那表情就像在说，你居然买甜菜？

sentences.en: And I was like, uh-huh.
And he goes, uh-huh, uh-huh.
Like, he so wanted to say something.
sentences.zh: 就好像他特别想说点什么。

sentences.en: Okay, so on Monday, I had to peel and cube the beets.
sentences.zh: 好了，周一的时候，我得把甜菜削皮切块。

sentences.en: It took an actual long time.
And then I had to get one liter of vodka, and I had to put the beets in a sealable container and pour vodka over the beets and shake it vigorously.
sentences.zh: 然后我得买一升伏特加，把甜菜放进密封容器里，倒入伏特加，然后用力摇晃。

sentences.en: Then I had to place the container in a cool, dark place and store it for three days.
sentences.zh: 接着我得把容器放在阴凉避光的地方，存放三天。

sentences.en: But twice a day, I had to go and shake it.
sentences.zh: 但每天还得去摇晃两次。

sentences.en: Oh, my gosh.
This is what I've been doing all week, and I wanted to tell you.
sentences.zh: 我这一周都在忙这个，我一直想告诉你。

sentences.en: I brought them.
I got individual little containers so we can all try my beet-infused vodka.
sentences.zh: 我准备了独立的小容器，这样我们大家都能尝尝我泡的甜菜伏特加。

sentences.en: I'm going to tell you, I tried it this morning.
sentences.zh: 我得先告诉你，我今天早上尝过了。

sentences.en: It is earthy.
Okay.
It's earthy.
I documented making it all.
sentences.zh: 我把制作过程全记录下来了。

sentences.en: I'll put it in stories.
Now, this is just, you don't do anything to the beets except cube them.
sentences.zh: 这个嘛，除了切块，你什么都不用对甜菜做。

sentences.en: Like, you didn't have to boil them or make them soft.
sentences.zh: 就是说，你不用煮熟或者弄软它们。

sentences.en: It's raw beet.
Yes, it's raw beets.
